items.headline: Escape Room opens with $949K buildout on Blossom Hill
items.summary: A permit for an assembly-use tenant improvement was issued for The Escape Room at 925 Blossom Hill Rd, valued at $949,000.

items.headline: Chagee tea shop permitted for Saratoga Ave location
items.summary: A $650,000 restaurant tenant improvement was permitted for Chagee at 1600 Saratoga Avenue, suite #201.

items.headline: Council to vacate public easement at Cerro Vista address
items.summary: The council is set to adopt a resolution summarily vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista, clearing the way for use of that portion of the property.
